description: Source code for the ConfigEntityAdapter class, which enhances EntityAdapter for configuration entities within Drupal, providing methods for property access, change notification, and typed data management.

classes.name: ConfigEntityAdapter
classes.description: A class that extends EntityAdapter to provide specialized handling for Drupal configuration entities, including property management and typed data integration.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a property value from the config entity, throwing an exception if the entity is not set.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a property value on the config entity, throwing an exception if the entity is not set.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns properties of the config entity, including computed ones if specified.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Notifies the typed data of a change in a property.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the config entity's data.

methods.name: getTypedConfigManager
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the typed config manager service.

methods.name: getTypedDataManager
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the typed data manager service.

methods.name: setTypedDataManager
methods.description: Sets the typed data manager and updates the typed config manager if applicable.

methods.name: applyDefaultValue
methods.description: Method not supported; intended for applying default values.

methods.name: getConfigTypedData
methods.description: Creates and returns typed data for the config entity based on its dependency name and data.
